meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. These are counts from each state court system's published statistics, kept for marketing planning. A case filed is a new case on a court's docket (in Texas, a new case or motion), not a person or a client. Check the state's current report.
meta.notice: Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice.

changes.summary: Corrected: Texas year-over-year comparisons for district-court criminal cases and statutory county-court family and felony cases now cover only counties with a comparable prior year; this year's counts are unchanged.

California added: superior courts in all 58 counties, fiscal year 2024–25 beside 2023–24, from the Judicial Council's Court Statistics Report (1,062 records, folded in from the California court filings dataset: injury, limited civil, eviction, small claims, felony, misdemeanor, traffic, divorce, parentage, domestic violence, child support, juvenile, guardianship, probate, mental health).

Maine added: superior courts, unified criminal dockets and district courts in all 16 counties, fiscal years 2021–22 to 2025–26, from the Maine Judicial Branch's caseload statistics (289 records: injury, contract, foreclosure, eviction, small claims, divorce, paternity, adoption, guardianship, protective orders, juvenile, mental health, criminal).

Nebraska added: county courts and district courts in all 93 counties plus the separate juvenile courts of Douglas, Lancaster and Sarpy, fiscal year 2024–25, from the Nebraska Judicial Branch's annual caseload reports (1,514 records: traffic, misdemeanor, felony, civil, small claims, probate, guardianship, adoption, domestic relations, protection orders, juvenile).

West Virginia added: circuit, family and magistrate courts in all 55 counties, calendar year 2025, from the Supreme Court of Appeals' Annual Statistics Report (728 records: general civil, small claims, felony, misdemeanor, divorce, other domestic relations, protective orders, juvenile, adoption, guardianship, mental health).

Oregon added: circuit courts in all 36 counties, calendar year 2025, from the Oregon Judicial Department's Cases Filed report (444 records: landlord-tenant, small claims, general civil, felony, misdemeanor, violations, divorce, other domestic relations, protective orders, juvenile, probate, civil commitment).

Pennsylvania added: courts of common pleas in all 67 counties, calendar year 2024, from the Administrative Office of Pennsylvania Courts county caseload reports (1,156 records: injury, mass tort, medical malpractice, contract and debt, landlord-tenant, foreclosure, criminal, protection from abuse, support, custody, divorce, juvenile, adoption, guardianship).

Virginia added: circuit, general district and juvenile and domestic relations district court filings for calendar year 2025 by locality, read from the Supreme Court of Virginia's caseload PDFs (2227 records).
New field fips on every record: the 2-digit state FIPS code on a state row, the 5-digit county FIPS code (or codes, where one court serves a city and a county together) on a county row.
Wisconsin read from the state's official file (1095 records).
